correctness.rationale: For every labelled simple G_n=C_n square K_2, n>=5, each cubic initial force must have a black neighbor triple T (three consecutive rim vertices) or R (two adjacent rim vertices plus a rung-mate). After either first force the common 4-black H has no available continuation. A fourth original seed x must lie among four boundary vertices u_-2,u_2,v_-1,v_1 to enable a second force; outside this set neither H nor x can force. The eight choices (T/R x four) reduce exactly to families A..E, and every prototype creates two adjacent fully black rungs, which propagate around the cycle. The five disjoint symmetry classes have sizes 2n,4n,4n,2n,n and total 13n. The boundary n=5 is included and n=3,4 are excluded by theorem. Independently enumerated all 3- and 4-vertex subsets and forced closure for n=5..9; compared actual sets with exact A..E construction and confirmed no 3-seeds, all 13n minimal 4-seeds. This finite corroboration does not justify all n; the first-force obstruction and propagation do.
residual_risks: Ordinary (not skew or PSD) zero forcing and minimal-cardinality seeds only.
